pipeline.modality: Logic-gated allogeneic CAR-NK cell therapy (CD33 OR FLT3) NOT EMCN, retroviral delivery
pipeline.target: CD33, FLT3 (with EMCN NOT-gate to spare HSCs)

indications.indication: Relapsed/refractory AML and higher-risk MDS (CD33+ and/or FLT3+ hematologic malignancies)
indications.trial_design: Open-label dose-escalation/expansion of SENTI-202 with lymphodepletion (fludarabine/cytarabine) in adults with CD33+ and/or FLT3+ blood cancers including AML/MDS
key_milestones: Positive preliminary AML data presented at AACR 2025

excluded_preclinical: Undisclosed solid-tumor CAR-NK candidate (discovery/preclinical, no IND)
